scenes.bubble: They always pay. Why review them?
scenes.caption: Year‑end customer credit reviews.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? Customers who always pay don't need a credit review.
cap: Customers who always pay don't need a *credit review*.

scenes.head: Still paying, but slower
scenes.note: Same customer. Same limit. Rising risk.
scenes.src: Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: In our view, myth. Take this illustrative customer. Still paying, but from forty-five days to seventy-eight in under a year. The limit never changed.
cap: Still paying, but from *45 days* to *78* in under a year.

scenes.say: Review payment days, exposure against the limit, and up-to-date information, before you renew the limit.
cap: Review *payment days*, *exposure* against the limit, and *up‑to‑date information*, before you renew the limit.

scenes.q: When did you last review limits?
scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: Our accounting and M.I.S. advisory sets up this review. Reviewing customer limits this month? Message us on WhatsApp.
